DEDICATED TO KIMBERLY,
AIDEN & LONDYN
AND
TREASURE HUNTERS EVERYWHERE

Where your pleasure is, there is your treasure:
where your treasure, there your heart;
where your heart, there your happiness.

-SAINT AUGUSTINE
